title: Lay out locomotion as an Isaac Lab project with separate scripts
summary: We arranged the locomotion code the way Isaac Lab arranges a project: robots, the omniwalk task with its agents configuration, RSL-RL extensions and scripts. Separate scripts train, evaluate a checkpoint and run diagnostics, and each pack names the script for its mode. The default command line reproduces the recorded c48_long configuration, and the guides, inventory and code map describe the new layout.
next: Run fresh native standing admission and the 13-probe parity of the unchanged c48_long checkpoint through its compatibility receipt on Spark.
reason: The change moves locomotion modules and splits the container entry point into train, play and diagnose scripts. It adds no motion result and changes no gate; native standing admission and the 13-probe parity of the changed physics identity stay pending.
